answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can earn, and keep new identities on a flat mesa of trust: they start at the lowest tier and only climb after a history of attested work. A sable ledger records completed jobs, failed deliveries, and peer ratings, so a flood of fresh clones cannot borrow reputation. Onboarding stays velvet-smooth, but payouts unlock gradually, and matching hardware or payment fingerprints collapse clones into one account, so a sybil farm must pay full stake per identity while earning only one identity's rewards.
